nodes.label: Knowledge Platform with Evidence and Provenance
nodes.rationale: LLM is not Knowledge: deterministic TypeScript store over table abstraction with SQLite persistence; memory adapter drives vitest.

nodes.label: KnowledgeService facade
nodes.rationale: Agents submit proposals; no direct graph mutation; propose-validate-commit owns all writes with idempotent events.

nodes.label: FACT promotion policy
nodes.rationale: Single LLM or agent claim never becomes FACT; requires 2 independent sources or one authoritative source type; bare LLM FACT claims downgraded to INFERENCE.
